turns.question: Who spent more per order in September 2026, our Turkish or our Dutch customers, and what was their average?
turns.answer: Turkish customers spent more per order: an average of 109.64 EUR per non-cancelled order, against 109.45 EUR for Dutch customers, over 1-30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
